news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems granted a new employee 90,000 restricted stock units and a non-qualified option to purchase 170,000 shares as a material inducement to employment, approved by independent directors under the company's Inducement Plan. The RSUs vest annually over three years, one-third per anniversary of the grant date.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Director Richard Kollender Exercises Stock Options
news.summary: Board member Richard S. Kollender exercised vested stock options on July 24, 2026, converting them into 3,508 Class A shares, bringing his direct holding to roughly 130,000 shares. No shares were sold in the filing.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems said it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results before market open on Friday, August 7, 2026. Management will host a webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day to discuss the results.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems (RPID) CEO Exercises Stock Options and Boosts Holdings
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully vested stock option for 1,402 Class A shares at $0.75 per share on July 22, 2026, ahead of the option's August 11, 2026 expiration. No shares were sold in the filing, leaving Spignesi with 1,191,973 directly held shares.

news.headline: RPID Affiliate Files Form 144 to Sell 10,000 Class A Shares
news.summary: A company affiliate filed notice on July 8, 2026 of intent to sell 10,000 Class A shares acquired via stock option exercise, part of a pattern of periodic smaller insider sales (5,000 shares on 6/10, 3,688 on 6/22, 6,312 on 7/1) rather than a single large disposal.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 financial results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET; investors will be watching for progress against the FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements after Q1's $8.0M revenue print and a wider-than-expected net loss.

catalysts.label: Third-quarter 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: No specific date has been announced yet, but based on prior-year cadence a Q3 2026 results release would be expected around early-to-mid November 2026, providing the next read on system placements and gross-margin trajectory.

pulse: Rapid Micro Biosystems heads into its Q2 2026 earnings report (August 7, before the open) still working through the fallout of a disappointing Q1 -- an 11% revenue gain to $8.0M was overshadowed by a wider-than-expected net loss and a dilutive ~$9.8M equity-and-warrant offering priced at $1.955/share in May, leaving the stock around $2 and a sub-$100M market cap despite reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct placements. News flow over the past six weeks has stayed routine -- inducement equity grants tied to continued hiring (August 3 and June 10) and small option-exercise/insider-sale filings from the CEO, a director, and other affiliates -- with no new customer orders, partnerships, or analyst rating changes disclosed since Samsung Biologics' follow-on order in March; sell-side coverage remains split between bullish (KeyBanc and Lake Street, Overweight/Buy, $8 targets) and cautious (Morgan Stanley, Equal-Weight, $2.75), with Friday's Q2 print set to be the next real test of whether system-placement and margin momentum is holding up.
